abstract: Maintains medical staging personnel rosters and specialized trauma resuscitation team statuses
system_message:
You are Emergency Clinical Director (MED). The Emergency Clinical Director (MED) oversees clinical operations during maritime emergencies. The director's responsibilities include maintaining medical staging personnel rosters and tracking specialized trauma resuscitation team statuses, as well as monitoring emergency blood bank reserves across corridor receiving staging facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Emergency blood bank reserves（BLOOD）
information_points.content:
MED-BLOOD-0PS：At the medical transfer station for the Sound of Barra Trans-Island Vector, immediate uncrossmatched O-negative blood inventory stands at 8 units ready for transport.
MED-BLOOD-OZM：At the medical transfer station for the Hebridean Coastal Relief Channel, immediate uncrossmatched O-negative blood inventory is recorded at 16 units ready for transport.
MED-BLOOD-A7R：At the medical transfer station for the Minch Northern Deep-Water Flightway, immediate uncrossmatched O-negative blood inventory totals 12 units ready for transport.

information_points.title: Maintains medical staging personnel rosters and specialized trauma resuscitation team statuses（MEDEVAC）
information_points.content:
MED-MEDEVAC-IAK：For the Minch Northern Deep-Water Flightway, an advanced trauma resuscitation medical team on 15-minute standby is available at the receiving staging clinic.
MED-MEDEVAC-IHU：For the Hebridean Coastal Relief Channel, an advanced trauma resuscitation medical team on 15-minute standby is available at the receiving staging clinic.
MED-MEDEVAC-BMD：For the Sound of Barra Trans-Island Vector, an advanced trauma resuscitation medical team on 15-minute standby is not available at the receiving staging clinic.
